items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, because I was close to her, obviously.

ctx.x: She’s from Ohio, Warren, and I’m from Youngstown.

Yes, because I was close to her, obviously. They’re looking for a new place. He’s been living in the same place for over 40 years, rent controlled, and they finally saw that he’s not living there six months and one day. They got to be there 181 days. After all these years, they checked. They finally found out that he doesn’t really live there anymore. She does. So he’s got to get out. They made a deal. They paid him off. He’s actively looking for a place, as we speak. He’ll be in – he comes in in three weeks for…
